name: Lancelot
source:
“My lady, if you don’t spend this million, don’t bother going home.”

The Academy’s founder and current headmaster. The ultimate domineering CEO type. Obsessed with building muscle—especially pecs—he’s infamous for teaching in a naked apron and punishing wrong answers with his “muscular wrath.” Rumors say he and his sister (who runs a language school) are secretly the “twin pillars of the market.”
